resources.resource: Clorox Free & Clear Multi Surface Cleaner, Spray Bottle, Fragrance Free, 32 fl oz (UPC 044600603346)
WypAll PowerClean L40 Extra Absorbent Towels, White, 12 x 12.5 in, 56 Count (05701)

step.action: Ask people using the tables to remove their belongings.
Put unattended belongings in Kitchen Lost and Found.
Put MOOP from on, under, and around the tables in Kitchen Waste Station.
Spray soiled table areas with Clorox Free & Clear Multi Surface Cleaner, Spray Bottle, Fragrance Free, 32 fl oz (UPC 044600603346).
Wipe the sprayed areas with one WypAll PowerClean L40 Extra Absorbent Towel until no food, visible dirt, or sticky residue remains.
Put the used towel in the trash container at Kitchen Waste Station.

passWhen.criterion: No food, visible dirt, or sticky residue remains on the tables.
No MOOP remains on, under, or around the tables.
